library.note: PLACEHOLDER coefficients: rough order-of-magnitude values in the range reported in the running/cutting literature, NOT BioScout simulations. Replace each phase with peak values from BioScout (Scale, IK, ID, SO, JRA) runs of lab trials of that task, scaled per body weight. Every value is a per-step peak: value = c0 + cv * speed (m/s) + ca * |acceleration| (m/s2).
